# Local Housing Solutions

> > A comprehensive resource for local officials on affordable housing policy, zoning reform, and housing strategy development.

Local Housing Solutions provides research-backed guidance on housing policy implementation, featuring the Housing Policy Library, Housing Solutions Lab research partnerships, and online training for small and midsize cities. The site covers federal programs (HUD, HOME, CDBG), zoning reform, anti-displacement strategies, and equitable housing development.

## Key Topics

- affordable housing
- zoning reform
- housing policy
- displacement prevention
- HUD programs
- HOME Investment Partnerships Program
- CDBG (Community Development Block Grant)
- inclusionary zoning
- housing vouchers
- small and midsize cities
- equitable housing
- affordable housing preservation
- missing middle housing
- rental assistance
- housing strategy development

## Getting Started: Housing Basics

- [What is Affordable Housing?](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-101-the-basics/what-is-affordable-housing): Housing 101 basics: defining affordable housing and cost burden concepts
- [Local Housing Solutions Online Training](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/local-housing-solutions-online-housing-training): Self-paced online training modules for local officials on housing strategy

## Housing Strategy & Planning

- [Developing an anti-displacement strategy](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/plan/developing-an-anti-displacement-strategy): Planning guide for developing anti-displacement and affordability strategies
- [Understanding neighborhood variation to inform a local housing strategy](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/plan/understanding-neighborhood-variation-to-inform-a-local-housing-strategy): Guide to neighborhood-level analysis for targeted housing strategy planning
- [Allocating resources to address housing needs among various household types](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/refine/allocating-resources-to-address-housing-needs-among-various-household-types-including-older-adults-and-families-with-children): Resource allocation strategies for diverse household types and demographics

## Zoning & Land Use Policy

- [Zoning](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-issues/zoning): Comprehensive guide to zoning policies for affordable housing development
- [Reforms to construction standards and building codes](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-library/reforms-to-construction-standards-and-building-codes): Guide to reforming building codes and construction standards to reduce costs
- [Charlottesville, Virginia's path to equitable zoning reform](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-case-studies/charlottesville-virginias-path-to-equitable-zoning-reform): Charlottesville's 2023 zoning overhaul for affordability and racial equity
- [Beyond the Minimum: Community Engagement Lessons From Oregon Zoning Reform](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-solutions-lab/our-research-and-partnerships/lab-grant-awardees/beyond-the-minimum-lessons-from-11-oregon-cities-on-community-engagement-in-zoning-reform): NYU Furman Center research on community engagement in Oregon zoning reforms

## Federal Programs & Rental Assistance

- [HOME Program: Tenant-Based Rental Assistance](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-library/home-tenant-based-rental-assistance): HUD HOME Program tenant-based rental assistance for low-income households
- [How Raising Voucher Payment Standards Expands Housing Choice](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-library/increased-voucher-payment-standards-in-high-cost-areas): Using SAFMRs and exception payments to expand voucher access in high-cost areas
- [Home repair and homeowner rehabilitation assistance programs](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-library/homeowner-rehabilitation-assistance-programs): CDBG and HOME-funded homeowner rehabilitation and repair assistance programs

## Affordable Housing Development & Preservation

- [Preservation of dedicated affordable housing](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-issues/preservation-of-dedicated-affordable-housing): Overview of preserving LIHTC and HUD-subsidized affordable housing stock
- [Developing mixed income housing](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/refine/developing-mixed-income-housing): Strategies for developing mixed-income housing using LIHTC and other tools
- [Limited equity cooperatives](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-policy-library/limited-equity-cooperatives): Limited equity cooperatives for long-term affordable homeownership

## Housing & Criminal Justice

- [Strategies to fund housing for people with criminal justice history](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/bridge/housing-criminal-justice-agencies-can-work-together/strategies-to-fund-housing-for-people-with-criminal-justice-history): Funding strategies for reentry housing using HUD vouchers and partnerships
- [Programs that collaborate to break the prison-homelessness cycle](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/bridge/housing-criminal-justice-agencies-can-work-together/programs-that-collaborate-to-break-the-prison-homelessness-cycle): Cross-agency programs addressing prison-homelessness cycle through housing

## Research & Case Studies

- [Learning From Housing Policy Innovation in Small and Midsize Cities: Update on Our 2022 Grantees](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/lab/notes/housing-policy-innovation-research-update-on-our-2022-grantees): 2022 grantee update on housing policy innovation research by Stanford & others
- [Philadelphia](https://www.localhousingsolutions.org/housing-strategy-profiles/philadelphia): Philadelphia's Housing for Equity Action Plan and affordability strategies
